caption: The drawing depicts a single, metallic teapot or coffeepot with a lid and a rounded finial on top. The pot is rendered in various shades of gray, indicating it is likely made of metal, with soft gradients suggesting reflected light and shadow. The teapot has a broad base that tapers slightly upward and is topped with a domed lid. The handle is on the left side, prominently angular with a thumb rest, and the spout is long and curves slightly upward on the right side. The background is plain and left uncolored, drawing attention solely to the detailed depiction of the pot. The name "GLENN WILSON" appears in capital letters near the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Pewter Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
